name: Marcus T.
text: Finally someone breaking down sight-reading into manageable chunks. I've been doing 20 minutes daily for 3 months and my students' confidence has noticeably improved. The key really is consistency over intensity.

name: Jennifer K.
text: Does anyone else struggle with getting their kids to actually do the routine every day? I find they lose interest after about a week. Maybe I need better materials?

name: Robert M.
text: This is exactly what I needed. Started with my 8-year-old last Monday and already seeing results. The progression from simple to complex makes so much sense.
